Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the evaluation. To keep the session efficient for both your security team and our engineers, we propose a two-hop walkthrough: a short executive overview followed by a separate technical deep-dive. High level plan: 

- Exec: 30 minutes — objectives, data flows, compliance posture, Q&A (suits risk/compliance leads)
- Tech: 60 minutes — architecture, controls, pen-test/segmentation details, evidence handoff (suits engineering/security)

Suggested slots (all in CET):
- Option 1: Tue 18 May — Exec 09:00–09:30, Tech 09:45–10:45
- Option 2: Wed 19 May — Exec 15:00–15:30, Tech 15:45–16:45

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (short checklist) and Network-arch-diagram.png (high-level) — I’ve attached the items we usually walk through. If you prefer a single consolidated session, we can compress to 45 minutes but will need to skip some evidence walkthroughs.

Please tell me which option works or share 2 windows that suit your team. I can send calendar invites separately: exec + tech, or a combined 45-min invite if you prefer.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

[Attached: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf, Network-arch-diagram.png]
